text.2:100: Is it ever so that when they make a covenant a party of them set it aside? The truth is, most of them believe not.
text.2:101: And when there cometh unto them a messenger from Allah, confirming that which they possess, a party of those who have received the Scripture fling the Scripture of Allah behind their backs as if they knew not,
text.3:187: And (remember) when Allah laid a charge on those who had received the Scripture (He said): Ye are to expound it to mankind and not to hide it. But they flung it behind their backs and bought thereby a little gain. Verily evil is that which they have gained thereby.
text.8:58: And if thou fearest treachery from any folk, then throw back to them (their treaty) fairly. Lo! Allah loveth not the treacherous.
text.20:96: He said: I perceived what they perceive not, so I seized a handful from the footsteps of the messenger, and then threw it in. Thus my soul commended to me.
text.28:40: Therefor We seized him and his hosts, and abandoned them unto the sea. Behold the nature of the consequence for evil-doers!
text.37:145: Then We cast him on a desert shore while he was sick;
text.51:40: So We seized him and his hosts and flung them in the sea, for he was reprobate.
text.68:49: Had it not been that favour from his Lord had reached him he surely had been cast into the wilderness while he was reprobate.
text.104:4: Nay, but verily he will be flung to the Consuming One.
